title: Animations in React Native
description: Learn how to create smooth and interactive animations in React Native to enhance user experience.

lessons.title: Why Use Animations?
lessons.content: Animations improve user engagement, provide visual feedback, and make the app feel lively and responsive. They guide users through interactions smoothly.

lessons.title: Introduction to the Animated API
lessons.content: React Native's Animated API is a powerful way to create performant animations. It provides a set of components and methods to animate values and styles.

lessons.title: Animated.Value and Interpolation
Basic Animation Types: Timing, Spring, Decay
lessons.content: Timing animations animate a value over time linearly or easing. Spring animations simulate spring physics for bounce effects. Decay animations slow down over time like a flick.

lessons.title: Animating Styles and Transforms
Animated.event for Gesture Handling
lessons.content: Animated.event maps gestures to animated values, allowing smooth, native-driven animations tied to user interactions like dragging or swiping.

lessons.title: LayoutAnimation for Layout Changes
lessons.content: LayoutAnimation lets you animate global layout changes (like adding/removing views) without manually animating each component.

lessons.title: Using React Native Reanimated Library
lessons.content: Reanimated is a powerful library that improves animation performance and allows complex gesture animations with a declarative API.

lessons.title: Animation Best Practices
lessons.content:
- Use `useNativeDriver` for better performance
- Keep animations subtle and meaningful
- Avoid animating too many properties at once
- Test on real devices for smoothness
